tei:div.tei:p: karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i

ma yi drin lan bshags mdo bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ don 'di las lhag pa gsung rgyu med/ /byams pas bstan cing snyan pa'i tshig /bu brtse ba'i sems kyi skyong ba'i drin chen ma| |spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ skyes pa'i mtha' mar nges par 'chi ba yin| kha drag can la cung zad sdod dbang med/ /gcig pur 'gro la phan pa dam pa'i chos/ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ 'grogs pa'i tha mar nges par 'bral ba yin/ /brtse gdung can la cung zad sdod dbang med/ /gcig pur 'gro la phan pa dam pa'i chos| |khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ bsags pa'i mtha' ni nges par zad pa la/ /ser sna can la cung zad khyer dbang med/ /gcig pur 'gro la phan pa dam pa'i chos/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ ma khyod 'di nas gcig pur 'gro ba la/ /nga dang khyod dang spyan ras gzigs dang gsum/ /'dzoms pa'i smon lam 'tshal lo drin chen ma| |khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khams gsum 'khor ba rigs drug gar skyes kyang*| |skye gnas bzhi po dag la brten nas skyes/ /brdzus te skye gnas gcig pur ma gtogs par/ /pha ma dag la brten nas gzugs su grub/ /las kyi dbang gis ma bur gyur pa'i tshe/ /zla dgu zhag bcu khur ba'i drin chen ma| |khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/

/spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ thig le rlung gis g.yo ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /sha rus kha khas bral ba'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ khrag dang chu ser lhan du btsas pa'i tshe/ /'o ma rnag khrag 'dres pa'i drin chen ma/ / khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ sha rus nyab nyob 'thib pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /phyag gi 'jam por blang ba'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ mig dang dbang po sgo lnga rnag pa'i tshe/ /kha 'jam lce yi bldag pa'i drin chen ma/ khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ mi gtsang dri ma kha ru song ba na/ /snang ba zhen pa ma log drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje| |spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ nyin mtshan med pa rum khung dron mor bcug |mchan khar 'bral med gtugs pa'i drin chen ma//khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ nub mo gti mug gnyid kyis khyer ba'i tshe/ /ma dag nub gnyid chags pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ pang du 'jam zhing bkod pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ sems la dga' spro 'dzoms pa'i drin chen ma/

/khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ rtag tu g.yo zhing dub pa'i tshul ston pa/ /mi bzod nu zho bsnun pa'i drin chen ma//khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ gnyid dus mig la ser bu phog pa'i dus/ /tsha grang myur du skyobs pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ rang lus rang gis srung rtsis med pa'i dus/ /na bza' gtsang 'jam byed pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje| |spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ / oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ rkang bzhi dud 'gro bzhin du 'gro ba'i dus| |rkang tshe gom tshe slob pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas lo gsum lon pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /gar 'gro mig gis 'tsho ba'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas lo lnga lon pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /gos lh+wam lam mchog ston pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ de nas lo bcu lon pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /sems kyi kho thag chod pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ sems la rtse gcig bsgoms pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/

/oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ gang la 'gro dbang yod pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol| |oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ 'gro nas rang dbang yod pa'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol| |oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ glo bur bdud kyis khyer ba'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje| |spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ khyer nas gar yod mi shes drin chen ma/ /rnam shes dbyer med rdzogs pa'i drin chen ma/ /brjod nas khro ba mi byed drin chen ma/ /bsam pa yang yang 'phrog pa'i drin chen ma/ /drin las mchi ma shor ba'i drin chen ma/ /khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa snying re rje/ /spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drang du gsol/ /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ ma khyod 'di nas lus sems bral ba'i tshe/ /zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar shog /skyes nas byang chub snying po thob par shog /thob nas sems can don kun mdzad du gsol| |don chen snying nas tshig gi sems la bcag /stug po bkod pa'i zhing 'dir rdo rje 'chang*/ /rnga yab gling nas padma 'byung gnas zhes/ /kha ba can na dpal ldan karma pa| |drin chen ma la drin lan sod par shog /oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrīḥ ces pa 'di yang karma pa rang byung rdo rjes ma yum gyi dṛn lan bshags pa'i mdo mdzad pa'o// // rje zhwa dmar drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i sdom pa nyer lnga pa bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /nangs mor bla mar dkon mchog rnams mngon sum bzhin du mdun gyi nam mkhar dpang po'i tshul du bzhugs par mos la/ mtshan mo rmi lam tshun du nyes pa byung tshad ltung bshags sam/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis sogs sam/ bla ma rdor 'dzin pa'am/ mgon po bdag ni lta bus snying nas bshags/

de nas thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i phyir/ /sdom pa'i tshul khrims nam yang mi nyams shing*| |bdag rgyud rnam par dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /'jigs tshe 'jig rten lha mir skyabs 'tshol dang*/ /chos spangs sman sngags rdzas bon sogs la skyabs/ /rab byung rtags dor khyim pa mu stegs 'grogs/ /skyabs 'gro gtong ba'i bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (1) /nyon mongs zhe sdang dbang gis srog gcod dang*/ /de dang cha mthun gsod sems gnod sems dang*/ /rdeg 'tshog bsngos sha gzhan la 'tshe ba'i las/ /lag tu len pa'i bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (2) /phyi rol rdzas la chags pa'i 'dod chags kyis/ /ma byin len pa dngos dang de'i cha mthun/ /gzhogs slong thob 'jal g.yo sgyus blang dang chang*/ /brnab sems ser sna'i bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (3) /nang gi lus la chags pa'i 'dod chags kyis| |mi tshangs spyod dang cha mthun khu ba 'byin/ /'khrig tshig sgeg chos 'phyar g.yeng rgod dang gar/ /'phyor 'dod rtsed mo'i bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (4) /gti mug dbang gis mi chos bla ma'i brdzun/ /cha mthun brdzun tshig gzhan la g.yo sgyu'i sems/ /dkon mchog las 'bras tshul la log lta dang*| |nga rgyal brdzun pa'i bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (5) /dug gsum gang rung gis bslangs pha rol po/ /'byed phyir phra ma dngos dang cha mthun gyis/ /rings thabs 'gyang thabs dkrug thabs 'khon thabs kyis/ /rtsod gzhir gyur pa'i bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (6) /nyon mongs zhe sdang gtso gyur pha rol la/ /tshig rtsub dngos dang skur 'debs lkog smras dang*| |'phya dang dmod 'bor gting tshig shub bu sogs//gnod 'tshe'i smras brjod bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (7) /nyon mongs dbang gis ngag kyal sna tshogs dang*/ /zer bzlos bskyar brjod bshug glu ku co 'don/ /'og 'gyu bon dang mu stegs bstod smad gleng*/

/sgro skur ngag kyal bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (8) /sems can blos spangs pha rol 'gyod pa bskyed| |slob dpon la yang khro bas mi snyan smras/ / 'gro ba rnams la g.yo sgyus spyod pa sogs/ /smon sems 'gal ba'i bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (9) /rnyed bkur chags pas bdag bstod gzhan smod dang*/ /chos nor mi ster bshags dang mi bzod dang*/ /theg chen spong zhing dam chos 'drar snang ston/ /'jug sems gtong ba'i bsam sbyor mi bya'o| (10) |sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can don slad du/ /bdag nyid sgyu mas sangs rgyas sgyu ma'i sku/ /sgrub la rtag chad 'dzin pa don dam pa'i/ /byang sems gtong ba'i bsam sbyor mi bya'o/ (11) /rdo rje slob dpon thugs dkrugs sun phyungs dang*/ /lus ngag yid kyis brnyas thabs bag med spyad| |bka' bcag skur 'debs smod dang yal bar 'dor| |rtsa ltung dang pos nyams par mi bya'o/ (12) /bla ma'i gdams ngag sangs rgyas bka' dang ni/ /tshad mar gyur pa'i bstan bcos dang 'gal ba'i/ /lta sgom spyod pa 'chol bar spyad pa sogs/ /rtsa ltung gnyis pas nyams par mi bya'o/ (13) /rdo rje'i spun la gnod 'tshe byed pa dang*//khros 'khrugs ngan g.yo tshig ngan dma' 'bebs sogs/ /dngos brgyud sgo nas gzhan sems sun 'byin pa'i/ /rtsa ltung gsum pas nyams par mi bya'o/ (14) /sems can rnams la byams pa'i sems spangs nas/ /dgra la ci gnod sdang sems gnod skyel dang*/ /gnod len gnod 'jal g.yo sgyu ngan bslus sogs/ /rtsa ltung bzhi pas nyams par mi bya'o/ (15) /spyi don dbang byas kun rdzob don dam gyi/ /byang sems nyams dang sbas don dbang byas nas| |rten gyi thig le brten pa bde chen nyams/ /rtsa ltung lnga pas nyams par mi bya'o/ (16) /phyi rol pa dang bye mdo sems tsam dang*/ /dbu ma pa sogs rang gzhan grub mtha' la/ /sdang bas dmod cing skur pa 'debs pa yi/ /rtsa ltung drug pas nyams par mi bya'o/

(17) /snod min rnams la dbang bskur rgyud 'chad dang*/ /man ngag ster dang grong chog gtor zlog srung*/ /gsang mi thub dang mthu gtad la sogs pa/ /rtsa ltung bdun pas nyams par mi bya'o/ (18) /rang gzhan phung khams gdod nas rdo rje gzhi'i/ /rgyu yin pa la ngan par blta ba dang*/ /byang chub bdag ltas mi thob ces spong ba'i/ /rtsa ltung brgyad pas nyams par mi bya'o| (19) |'khrul med rgyu 'bras theg pa'i dam chos la/ /the tshom som nyis spong bar byed pa'am/ /yid mi ches pas yal bar 'dor ba yi/ /rtsa ltung dgu pas nyams par mi bya'o| (20) |bla ma la sdang dkon mchog gsum la gnod/ /chos spong mtshams med byed pa'i skye bo la/ /'di ltos 'brel pas phyogs 'dzin byams gdung gi/ /rtsa ltung bcu pas nyams par mi bya'o/ (21) /ming dang bsam brjod spros bral gnas lugs la/ /sgro 'dogs pa dang skur ba 'debs pa dang*/ /rtag chad mtshan ma'i mtha' ru 'dzin pa yi| |rtsa ltung bcu gcig pa yang mi bya'o/ (22) /pha rol dag pa'i zhing la skur ba dang*/ /sbyin bdag la sogs skye bo sun phyung dang*/ /sgo gsum sgo nas skye rgu gtser bgyid pa'i/ /rtsa ltung bcu gnyis pa yang mi bya'o/ (23) /so sor thar dang byang sems gsang sngags kyi/ /sdom pa dam tshig blangs shing dam bcas pa/ /btang dang nyams dang 'gal bar bgyid pa yi/ /rtsa ltung bcu gsum pa yang mi bya'o/ (24) /las rgya bud med chos rgya snang ba kun/ /dam rgya gtum mo ye rgya sgom pa'i lha/ /gnyis med phyag chen smod cing spong ba yi/ /rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa yang mi bya'o/ (25) /rgyal ba kun gyi rjes su slob gyur te/ /bzang po spyod pa yongs su rdzogs byed cing*//tshul khrims spyod pa dri med yongs dag par/ /rtag tu ma nyams skyon med spyod par shog/ ces rje chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i sdom pa nyer lnga pa tshig don dran bzhin du brjod la dam bca'i go cha brtan po byas te/

'gro 'dug spyod lam thams cad kyi skabs su'ang bag yod dran shes dang ma bral bas sdom gsum gyi bslab bya de dag dang nam yang ma 'gal bar bya/ dgong mo rang rgyud la ltung bas gos ma gos brtag nas ma gos pa'i dge rtsa sems can gyi don tu bsngo/ gos pa la khyad par du bshags sdom bya dgos pa yin kyang*/ deng sang dus dbang gis ltung bas ma gos pa cher mi 'byung bas/ dmigs 'dun bshags pa snga ma ltar gang lcogs dang*/ sdom pa nyer lnga pa'i tshig 'jug skyabs 'gro btang ba'i bsam sbyor byas pa bshags/ /sogs nas/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi nyams pa mthol lo bshags// zhes pa'i bar bshags tshig tu bsgyur bas nyes pa bshags te/ dus rtag tu sdom gsum gyi rtsa ba tsam la nyes pas ma gos pa zhig byung na thar pa'i lam sna zin par 'gyur gyi/ nyes ltung gi khur po khur nas ltar snang gi sgom sgrub ci byas kyang ngan song las skyob par dka'o// 1 7skyabs rje khra 'gu rin po ches mdzad pa'i blang dor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /ma 'dris 'gro ba'i bshes gnyen ston mchog la/ /mi phyed dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas/ /tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa'i grogs rnams la/ /lhag bsam

dag pas blang dor bslab bya spel/ /drin can pha ma'i re ba bskang phyir dang*/ /rang gi 'di phyi'i don chen rgyur nges pas| |mar 'dren col chung rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /kun slong ma nor ma brjed lag len mdzod/ / ( dor bya nyer gcig ) (1) tshangs spyod (2) lag gtsang (3) blo thub (4) yon tan brtson/ (5) /myos byed (6) sho (7) sbag (8) ta se (9) tha ma kha| (10) |mtha' mi'i gos dang (11) sngo ljang (12) khyim pa'i chas| (13) |skra ring (14) mtshan mo grong pa'i khrod du 'khyams| (15) |kha btsog (16) don med kha gyong (17) rdung rdeg byed/ (18) /'grul pa mgo skor (19) glog brnyan khang du 'gro/ (20) /'thab rtsod (21) bud med rtse rnaṃs rgyun du spongs| | ( blang bya nyer gcig ) (22) chos gos (23) gding ba (24) rdor dril (25) ḍa ma ru/ (26) /bsgrig zhal (27) phor ras (28) dril gdan (29) shu ka li/ (30) /rgyun mkho'i phyag dpe (31) dpe ras dang bcas pa/ (32) /bris chas (33) sbyang deb mkho ba'i yo byad gcang*/ (34) /gzan (35) sham (36) stod 'gag (37) smad g.yogs (38) rngul len dang*| (39) |dmar ser lh+wam bcas (40) gtsang mar (41) tshul mthun bgo/ (42) /rang 'khris las 'gan 'thus shor med par gces/ /de skad dge ba'i bshes gnyen ming 'dzin pa/ /khra 'gu ba yi brtse bas gdams par bris/
